**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**


_The DAC Enrollment Web Service functions to submit record(s) in one transaction to the Telos ID DAC._
_The enrollment record(s) consists of the applicant’s biographic, citizenship, employment, documentation,_
_fingerprints and badge data._


The DAC Enrollment Web Service exists to submit a single record or multiple records in one transaction
to the Telos ID DAC. The enrollment data should consist of an enrollment’s biographic, citizenship,
badge, employment, documentation, and fingerprint information. If an EFTS file is provided, it must be
properly formatted as per EBTS 10.0. The specific data contents are described in the following sections.
Once the enrollment record has successfully been received by Telos, a synchronous acknowledgement
message is submitted back to the sponsor.


For all transaction types, the incoming requests must contain the entire application data set, even if the
data has not changed. If an update transaction contains null fields, this implies that Telos will remove
data in these fields.


1.1.1 CREATE ENROLLMENT TRANSACTION


This transaction type is used for all new enrollments of applicants. It will not be used to update
information of currently enrolled applicants. This transaction will contain all data described as
mandatory information by the validation criteria for the program to which the applicant has applied. It
should contain as much of the available data that is described as optional information.


All Create Enrollment Full Package (FP) and Fingerprint Only (FPO) requests must include the Search and
Subscribe identifiers in the MiscellaneousFieldType key/value pair as
“RapBackTransactionType/SearchAndSubscribe”. Any Create Enrollment FP or FPO transaction requests
that does not contain these identifiers will be defaulted and processed as a Search and Subscribe
transaction requests.


_Note: As per the Rap Back Overview and Privacy Informational Briefing for Airports and Aircraft_
_Operators dated September 2021, TSA has listed specific criteria that must be met in the Federal Register_
_Notice for airport and aircraft operators for conducting the CHRC and subscribing the individual in Rap_
_Back. The FingerprintType Agency Code must now match the respective submitting sponsor_
_airport/airline agency code in all Create Enrollment transaction requests. A submission with a_
_FingerprintType Agency Code value that is different than the respective submitting sponsor_
_airport/airline agency code will be rejected beginning on March 29, 2022._

**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**


1.1.2 UPDATE BIOGRAPHIC TRANSACTION


This transaction type is used for updating an applicant’s biographic information. This includes updating
the applicant’s name, personal information, birth information, citizenship information, employment
information, and contact information.


For AW/ACP populations, this transaction can also update badge information. For GA, this transaction
can also update Employer information and status. The statuses for badges for AW/ACP and the statuses
for employments for GA will be used to keep the overall status as active or marked for deletion.


The following general rules apply for this transaction type:


  - This transaction should include all mandatory and optional data as described in the validation
criteria, and as required by the enrollment program.

  - No update transaction types will be processed until 72 hours after the initial enrollment or an
update has been sent to Telos. If an update request is sent within that time period an error
message will be returned similar to the following: “Update cannot be processed at this time.
Update request cannot be processed until after the enrollment or update application is 72 hours
old”.

  - The sponsor may provide additional details that explain why certain data has been corrected
(i.e., “Name changed. Legal document presented.”). This comment will be placed in the
transactionReason field.

  - All list elements will replace current list elements that Telos has. For instance, if Telos has one
badge list and a sponsor sends an empty badge list. Telos will wipe out the one badge in the
system with an empty list. List elements include badges and employment.

`o` With exception to documents, if no documents are provided, the current document list
will remain unchanged. If any documents are submitted, they will completely replace
the existing document list.

  - If this transaction was initiated by a rejection by TSA for data issues on an enrollment request or
update transaction and the original data is correct as originally submitted, the transaction will
include a comment added to the transaction reason, “Data correct as submitted”.

  - The Sponsors must send an update with an active badge, for badged populations, within one
year of receiving a STA or the badge will be marked for deletion.


1.1.3 UPDATE BADGE TRANSACTION


This transaction is used to update badge information and is the only transaction that does not require
complete biographic information. The transaction only requires the updated list of badge information.
This transaction will contain all data described as mandatory information by the validation criteria for
the program to which the applicant has applied.

**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**


This transaction type is used for updating an applicant’s biometric (fingerprint) data. This transaction
will occur after a Biometric Result has indicated that the fingerprint was not able to be processed. This
transaction also can occur when an applicant must resubmit fingerprints due to program rules (i.e. be
screened every two years) – reenrollment or rescreening of existing applications.


This transaction should include all mandatory and optional data as described in the validation criteria,
and as required by the enrolling program. This transaction should include all data pertaining to these
fields whether that data is being updated or not. If a data element in the transaction is sent with a null
value, the system will update that data to null.


No update transaction types will be processed until 72 hours after the initial enrollment has been sent.
If an update request is sent within that time period an error message will be returned similar to the
following: “Update cannot be processed at this time. Update requests cannot be processed until after
the enrollment application is 72 hours olds.”


All Update Biometric Full Package (FP) and Fingerprint Only (FPO) requests must include a valid value in
the MiscellaneousFieldType key/value field. An Update Biometric FP or FPO transaction requests that
does not contain these identifiers will be defaulted and processed as a Search and Subscribe transaction
request and will be accepted or rejected accordingly to the Rap Back validation rules.


_Note: As per the Rap Back Overview and Privacy Informational Briefing for Airports and Aircraft_
_Operators dated September 2021, TSA has listed specific criteria that must be met in the Federal Register_
_Notice for airport and aircraft operators for conducting the CHRC and subscribing the individual in Rap_
_Back. The FingerprintType Agency Code must now match the respective submitting sponsor_
_airport/airline agency code in all Update Biometric transaction requests. A submission with a_
_FingerprintType Agency Code value that is different than the respective submitting sponsor_
_airport/airline agency code will be rejected beginning on March 29, 2022._

1.1.6 CANCEL ENROLLMENT TRANSACTION


This transaction type has been deprecated.


1.1.7 CANCEL DELETE TRANSACTION


This transaction type has been deprecated.


1.1.8 REGISTER ENROLLMENT TRANSACTION


This transaction is used to register enrollments to the DAC. This transaction may NOT be combined with
other transactions types. The purpose of this transaction is to import enrollment information directly to
the DAC but not submit any other type of transaction to TSA. This is only to begin the process for an
enrollment and the workflow will have to continue directly on the Telos DAC Portal by some operator.
No Ingest, Biometric, or STA results will be returned from this transaction until other transactions are
submitted directly from the Telos DAC Portal.


This transaction will contain all data described as mandatory information by the validation criteria.


1.1.9 RAP BACK TRANSACTIONS


The DAC Enrollment Web Service supports the Rap Back function. In order to submit any kind of Rap
Back transaction, requests must be made by using different combinations of the transaction type and
miscellaneous field types list.


These transactions will contain all data described by the validation criteria.

1.1.9.1 SEARCH AND RETAIN TRANSACTION


This Rap Back transaction is used to submit a criminal history search and mark the fingerprint file to be
retained by the FBI. This transaction type is automatically done by any Create Enrollment or Update
Biometric transaction that requires fingerprints. This transaction type does not automatically create the
Rap Back subscription. In order to subscribe, you must submit a Create Rap Back Subscription
transaction later on in the process.


_Note: As per the Rap Back Overview and Privacy Informational Briefing for Airports and Aircraft_
_Operators dated September 2021, to ensure that only individuals who have been subscribed in Rap Back_
_are issued SIDA and/or Sterile Area ID media, TSA will remove the ability for aircraft operators and_
_airport operators to use the “Search and Retain” transaction after March 29, 2022. This includes all AW,_
_ACP, and FAC Create Enrollment and Update Biometric submissions going forward after that date. At_
_that time, airports and aircraft operators will be required to use, per their security programs, the CHRC_
_Search and Subscribe function for all initial CHRCs._


1.1.9.2 SEARCH AND SUBSCRIBE TRANSACTION


This Rap Back transaction is used to submit a criminal history search and mark the fingerprint file to be
retained by the FBI. This transaction type can be done by any create enrollment or update biometric
that requires fingerprints. This transaction type automatically creates the Rap Back subscription. In the
event that another existing subscription is present in the case being used, and depending on the status
of that existing subscription, the search an subscribe request will either be accepted if the existing
subscription has been expired or canceled for more than 60 days, or the search and subscribe request
will be rejected if the existing subscription can still be replaced or uncancel if it is within 60 days of
having been expired or canceled.


1.1.9.3 CREATE RAP BACK SUBSCRIPTION TRANSACTION


This Rap Back transaction is used to create a rap back subscription. This transaction is only to be used
following a previously submitted Search and Retain transaction and where the UCN and EVI values are
present and available for that submission. This transaction type can be done in an update biometric
request only. A case should not have a current Rap Back subscription for this transaction to be
accepted. In the event that another existing subscription is present in the case being used, and
depending on the status of that existing subscription, the create a rap back subscription request will
either be accepted if the existing subscription has been expired or canceled for more than 60 days, or
the create rap back subscription request will be rejected if the existing subscription can still be replaced
or uncancel if it is within 60 days of having been expired or canceled.


1.1.9.4 MAINTENANCE REPLACE TRANSACTION


This Rap Back transaction is used to make edits to a current Rap Back subscription. The replace
transaction is used to update the subscription record’s name, date of birth, or rap back subscription

When replacing the rap back subscription expiration date the replace request will go through a

subscription being replaced has been expired for more than 60 days then the replace transaction will be
rejected.


1.1.9.5 MAINTENANCE CANCEL TRANSACTION


This Rap Back transaction is used to make edits to a current Rap Back subscription. The cancel
transaction is used to cancel a rap back subscription. A case must have a current active Rap Back
subscription for this transaction to be accepted.


1.1.9.6 MAINTENANCE UNCANCEL TRANSACTION


This Rap Back transaction is used to make edits to a current Rap Back subscription. The uncancel
transaction is used to uncancel a rap back subscription. A rap back subscription can only be uncanceled
within 60 days from when a previous rap back subscription was cancelled or when the subscription
reached its expiration date. In the event that an uncancel transaction request that is received after 60
days from the date the subscription was cancelled the subscription is considered unmodifiable at that
point and therefore the request will be rejected.


1.1.10 E-BADGE TRANSACTION


This E-Badge transaction is used to forward information on to CBP’s E-Badge program. Currently,
functionality is very limited. E-Badge is only supported for AW program and FP/PFP subprograms and
Create Enrollment and Update Biographic transactions.

1.3 MESSAGE DETAILS


1.3.1 BIOMETRIC RESULTS


The Biometric Result message is generated when the biometric vetting processing results are received
by TSA. These results will be placed in a Biometric Result element. This result message will only be
generated if the enrollment’s designated business process includes biometric processing. The Biometric
Results element may contain multiple Biometric Result elements. The Biometric Result element may
contain multiple subordinate attributes/elements.


1.3.2 STA RESULTS


The Security Threat Assessment (STA) Result message will be generated when an enrollment is initially
enrolled or when perpetual vetting changes a previously delivered STA Result. These findings will be
placed in a STA Result element.  The STA Results element may contain multiple STA Result elements.
The STA Result element contains multiple subordinate attributes/elements.


1.3.3 INGEST RESULTS


The Ingest Results contains the summary of TSA processing results for the enrollment submitted by the
DAC. The Ingest Results element may contain multiple Ingest Result elements that contain enrollment
processing results.


The Ingest Result element is generated during the enrollment import process to acknowledge both
positive and negative initial processing results. When a format or semantic error is detected within the
application, the Ingest Error element may contain multiple subordinate elements that contain
enrollment error identifications.


If no errors are returned, this will be interpreted as a confirmation of update requests and
acknowledgement of delete requests.


1.3.4 RAP BACK RESULTS


The Rap Back Result message is generated when rap back transaction results are received by TSA. These
results will be placed in a Biometric Result element. This result message will only be generated if the
enrollment’s designated business process includes rap back processing. The Rap Back Results element
may contain multiple Biometric Result elements. The Biometric Result element will contain a

1.3.5 DELETE NOTIFICATION RESULTS


The Delete Notification Result message is generated when a Delete Case transaction is submitted and
subsequently processed by TSA; this type of delete notification is considered a “real delete” and will not
have the delete notification text filled in. The other type of Delete Notification Result message is
generated when TSA has added a delete date to the case record to determine the date the case record
will be deleted from TSA’s system; this type of delete notification is considered a “potential delete” and
will have the delete notification text filled in. A Delete Notification will only be generated if the
enrollment’s designated business process includes delete notification processing. The Delete
Notification Results element may contain multiple Delete Notification Result elements. The Delete
Notification Result element contains multiple subordinate attributes/elements.

**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**


The DAC Message Delivery Web Service is a secure web service call used to request messages from the
DAC. A Sponsor can submit a request to check for any queued messages. The DAC will respond
synchronously with any queued messages for the requested Sponsor. Messages will include biometric
results, STA results, and ingest results.


The DAC Message Delivery Web Service also has the capability to query for a specific enrollment by the
unique enrollment id and return case data that includes latest STA, CHRC, eBadge, and current Rap Back
data if available.


2.2 INTERFACE DETAILS


2.2.1 WSDL LOCATION


Demo URL:


[https://dacws.mobileassure.com/DACMessageDeliveryWS/DACMessageDeliveryWS.svc?wsdl](https://dacws.mobileassure.com/DACMessageDeliveryWS/DACMessageDeliveryWS.svc?wsdl)


Production URL:


[https://dac3ws.tsadac.com/DACMessageDeliveryWS/DACMessageDeliveryWS.svc?wsdl](https://dac3ws.tsadac.com/DACMessageDeliveryWS/DACMessageDeliveryWS.svc?wsdl)


2.3 MESSAGE DETAILS


2.3.1 BIOMETRIC RESULTS


The Biometric Result message is generated when the biometric vetting processing results are received
by TSA. These results will be placed in a biometricResults element. This result message will only be
generated if the enrollment’s designated business process includes biometric processing. It may contain
multiple biometricResults elements. The biometric Result element may contain subordinate
attributes/elements.


2.3.2 STA RESULTS
The Security Threat Assessment (STA) Result message will be generated when and enrollment is initially
enrolled or when perpetual vetting changes a previously delivered STA Result. These findings will be
placed in a staResult element. It may contain multiple staResults elements. The staResults element
contains multiple subordinate attributes/elements.

A request must be made with Telos ID to receive “Administratively Closed” and “Awaiting Applicant
Response” results. This has to be configured to be sent back due to this being a newer result type and
developers need to state they are ready to receive this result.

**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**


2.3.3 INGEST RESULTS


The Ingest Results contains the summary of TSA processing results for the enrollment submitted by the
DAC. It may contain multiple ingestResult elements that contain enrollment processing results.


The ingestResult element is generated during the enrollment import process to acknowledge both
positive and negative initial processing results. When a format or semantic error is detected within the
application, the ingestResult element may contain multiple subordinate elements that contain
enrollment error identifications.


If no errors are returned, this will be interpreted as a confirmation of update requests and
acknowledgement of delete requests.


2.3.4 RAP BACK RESULTS


The Rap Back Result message is generated when the rap back transaction results are received by TSA.
These results will be placed in a rapBackResults element. This result message will only be generated if
the enrollment’s designated business process includes rap back processing. The Rap Back Results
element will be placed in a BiometricResult element and may contain multiple BiometricResult
elements. The Biometric Result element will contain a RapBackRecord element which may contain
multiple subordinate attributes/elements. A request must be made with Telos ID to receive Rap Back
results. This has to be configured to be sent back due to this being a newer result type and developers
need to state they are ready to receive this result.


2.3.5 DELETE NOTIFICATIONS


The Delete Notification Result message is generated when a Delete Case transaction is submitted and
subsequently processed by TSA; this type of delete notification is considered a “real delete” and will not
have the delete notification text filled in. The other type of Delete Notification Result message is
generated when TSA has added a delete date to the case record to determine the date the case record
will be deleted from TSA’s system; this type of delete notification is considered a “potential delete” and
will have the delete notification text filled in. These results will be placed in a deleteNotificationResults
element. A Delete Notification will only be generated if the enrollment’s designated business process
includes delete notification processing. The Delete Notification Results element may contain multiple
DeleteNotificationResult elements. The Delete Notification Result element contains multiple
subordinate attributes/elements. A request must be made with Telos ID to receive Delete Notification
results. This has to be configured to be sent back due to this being a newer result type and developers
need to state they are ready to receive this result.

**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**





Web Service is designed in accordance with TSA Technical standards for web applications


Web service authentication is based on Active Directory accounts assigned in AD for the web service.


Firewall will allow access to the web service from known IP address.


Encryption is using SSL configured for FIPS 140-2 level 1 encryption with certificates

3.2 INTERFACE SECURITY DETAILS


Web Service access is initiated by the requesting agent. The requesting agent established a SSL
connection to the web service. The Firewall will only allow access from known IP addresses. Once the
SSL link is established the requesting service can make a request to the web service. The web server will
verify each request using active directory accounts.


3.3 MESSAGE SECURITY DETAILS


All fields in the web service have shall be protected for command injection attempts.


Firewall is configured to protect for DOS attacks.


Input violation will be performed on all data input fields


The following sub-sections briefly describe the data validation requirements for more descriptive
validation requirements.

Country codes shall comply with ISO 3166 Country Codes.

**Telos Confidential & Proprietary Information**


4.1.1 SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER VALIDATION

The system will validate the Social Security Numbers (SSN) according to the following rules:


  - SSN shall be composed of nine (9) digits.

  - SSN shall not start with a nine (9).

  - SSN shall not contain all zeros (0’s) in any digit group

[Example: (000-XX-XXXX) (XXX-00-XXXX) (XXX-XX-0000)].

  - SSN shall not begin with three (3) consecutive sixes (6’s)
(Example: 666-XX-XXXX).

  - SSN shall not be greater than or equal to (>=) 987-65-4320; and less than or
equal to (<=) 987-65-4329.

  - SSN shall not be equal to 078-05-1120.


4.1.2 ALIEN REGISTRATION NUMBER VALIDATION (8-10 CHARACTERS)

The system will validate the Alien Registration Number (ARN) according to the following rules:


  - ARN shall not be equal to nine (9) consecutive eights (8’s) (Example: 888888888).

  - ARN shall not be equal to nine (9) consecutive nines (9’s) (Example: 999999999).


4.1.3 LAST NAME VALIDATION (2-40 CHARACTERS)

The system will validate last names according to the following rules:


  - Last name shall be a minimum of 1 alphabetic character long.

  - Last name shall only include letters A-Z, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.

  - Last name shall not be composed of all spaces, hyphens, and apostrophes.

  - Last name shall not start with a hyphen.

  - Last name shall not start with an apostrophe.

  - Last name shall not start with a space.

  - Last name shall not end with a hyphen.

  - Last name shall not end with an apostrophe.

  - Last name shall not end with a space.

  - Last name shall not include two or more consecutive non-alphabetic characters (hyphens,
apostrophes, and spaces).

  - All last names submitted as part of an enrollment must meet all of the stated validation rules.


4.1.4 FIRST NAME VALIDATION (0-40 CHARACTERS)

The system will validate first names according to the following rules:


  - First name shall be a minimum of 1 alphabetic character long.

  - First name shall not be composed of all spaces, hyphens, and apostrophes.

  - First name shall not start with a hyphen.

  - First name shall not start with an apostrophe.

  - First name shall not end with a hyphen.

  - First name shall not end with a space.

  - First name shall not include two or more consecutive non-alphabetic characters (hyphens,

4.1.5 MIDDLE NAME VALIDATION (0-40 CHARACTERS)

The system will validate middle names according to the following rules:


  - Middle name shall be a minimum of 1 alphabetic character long.

  - Middle name shall only include letters A-Z, hyphens, apostrophes, and spaces.

  - Middle name shall not be composed of all spaces, hyphens, and apostrophes.

  - Middle name shall not start with a hyphen.

  - Middle name shall not start with an apostrophe.

  - Middle name shall not start with a space.

  - Middle name shall not end with a hyphen.

  - Middle name shall not end with an apostrophe.

  - Middle name shall not end with a space.

  - Middle name shall not include two or more consecutive non-alphabetic characters (hyphens,
apostrophes, and spaces).

In the event an applicant does not have a middle name or one was not provided, it is not valid to submit
the following list of non-case sensitive identifiers to reflect the lack of a middle name:


  - NMN, No Middle name, NMI, no middle name, None, N/A, NMM, nm, mnm, mnn, no name, NME


4.1.6 DATE OF BIRTH VALIDATION

The system will validate date of birth according to the following rules:


  - DOB shall be a valid Gregorian date.

  - DOB shall not be greater than (>) the current date.

  - DOB shall not be less than (<) the result of following calculation (“current date” – 115 years).

  - AGE CANNOT be 11 and younger or 105 and older.

4.1.10 RACE

According to the following system rules, race shall be:


  - B = Black

  - A = Asian

  - W = White/Caucasian

  - U = Unknown

  - I = American Indian/Alaskan Native


Note: These codes have been standardized by the Federal Bureau of Investigation in the NCIC code
manual. You may notice that Hispanic is not included in these codes. The FBI classifies Hispanic as
an ethnic indicator, not a race. Hispanics should be entered with the race code most clearly
representing the individual.


4.1.11 SEX

  - M = Male

  - F = Female

  - U = Unknown

  - SC = Security Coordinator

     - Key – “ **RapBackTransactionType”**


     - Value – “ **CreateRapBackSubScription** ”

Transaction Type – **UpdateBiometric**


Add MiscellaneousFieldType


     - Key – “ **RapBackTransactionType** ”


     - Value – “ **MaintenanceReplace** ”


Add MiscellaneousFieldType with the appropriate key


     - Key – “ **ExpirationDate”*, “DateOfBirth”, “FirstName”, “MiddleName”, “LastName”, or “Suffix”**


     - Value – [Data that needs to be replaced]


_* Validation of Expiration date value will be conducted for whether value date is a valid date and date does not_
_exceed 2 years from request submission date._
